novelty_comparisons.shared_concepts: Restores omitted numerator and denominator statistics within a cache budget.
novelty_comparisons.difference_in_aurelis: AURELIS introduces a delayed solve-free recurrent state S to predict unread observations and derives a deterministic normalizer error bound Eq. (10).
novelty_comparisons.empirical_verdict: ResKV's intuition that unread mass can be compensated is valid, but using a recurrent matrix S to predict unread values does not outperform per-page static center statistics (Eq. 13).

novelty_comparisons.shared_concepts: Query-dependent page key coordinate bounds [k^-, k^+] for sparse page selection.
novelty_comparisons.difference_in_aurelis: Quest selects top-K pages based solely on max key score without error bounds. AURELIS introduces residual-sensitive priority heuristic and deterministic certification.
novelty_comparisons.empirical_verdict: Value-sensitive selection prevents catastrophic errors when low-mass pages contain huge value outliers, but Quest's simple key-bounding remains a cheaper page filter.

novelty_comparisons.shared_concepts: Runtime error certification with fallback to exact data.
novelty_comparisons.difference_in_aurelis: Quantized attention certifies quantization noise in stored keys/values. AURELIS certifies complete structural omission of unread remote pages.
novelty_comparisons.empirical_verdict: Quantization error certification is tightly bounded and useful; structural omission certification requires conservative exponential intervals that often force full reads unless tolerance is loose.

novelty_comparisons.baseline: Hybrid Recurrent Architectures (Based, Infini-attention, NHA, Nemotron-H)
novelty_comparisons.shared_concepts: Couples recurrent state with recent attention window cache.
novelty_comparisons.difference_in_aurelis: Hybrids use heuristic linear or learned fusion. AURELIS investigated mass-consistent archive completion to guarantee full softmax recovery in real arithmetic.
novelty_comparisons.empirical_verdict: The solve-free recurrent state S is efficient in bounded mode (O(d_v d_k + w(d_k + d_v))), but coupling it to an exact archive for certified retrieval adds overhead without beating static page summaries.
